config.label: App name stamped on this server's writes (written_by becomes stdio:<name>)
config.description: App name stamped on this server's writes (written_by becomes stdio:<name>). 1-40 characters a-z 0-9 . _ -. Self-declared, not authenticated.

config.label: Data directory (database, tokens)
config.description: Data directory (database, tokens). Default: ~/.monomem (Windows: the .monomem folder in your user profile); an existing ~/.onememory store is kept in place, as is a checkout's ./data/state.db.

config.label: SQLite file path, overriding the data directory for the database only
config.description: SQLite file path, overriding the data directory for the database only. Default: <data dir>/state.db.
